decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that builds directly on the firm's established automation offer, it is a low-cost option to keep open while the firm gathers more demand evidence in a growing market.

Because it extends the existing loading and productivity portfolio and likely shares capabilities, channels, and service resources with the core business, the firm would usually continue it rather than exit after only one year.

Although this dispensing machine is more distant from the firm's established offer and therefore somewhat riskier, its flagship status and early positive signal from the Red Dot award make it worth retaining as a strategic growth option.
